new_string:
/* 7.0.12 port: <linux/bits.h> already defines BIT()/BITS() (BITS as a
 * different-arity macro). The stock driver relies on its own single-token
 * BIT() and 2-arg BITS(m,n) semantics, so force-override both. */
#ifdef BIT
#undef BIT
#endif
#define BIT(n)                          ((UINT_32) 1UL << (n))

#ifdef BITS
#undef BITS
#endif
/* bits range: for example BITS(16,23) = 0xFF0000
 *   ==>  (BIT(m)-1)   = 0x0000FFFF     ~(BIT(m)-1)   => 0xFFFF0000
 *   ==>  (BIT(n+1)-1) = 0x00FFFFFF
 */
#define BITS(m,n)                       (~(BIT(m)-1) & ((BIT(n) - 1) | BIT(n)))
why: DELTA de tipos: gl_typedef.h redefine BIT()/BITS() y colisiona con linux/bits.h. En 7.0.12 el #ifndef BIT no dispara (ya definido), dejando la BITS(m,n) del kernel (arity distinta) -> el core rompe. #undef + redefine garantiza la semantica stock.
wakelock.h eliminado de mainline. Guardado tras CFG_ENABLE_WAKE_LOCK (no definido) -> no se incluye; los wakelocks pasan a no-op.
asm/uaccess.h -> linux/uaccess.h en 7.0.12. kfifo/cdev solo los usa BOW (GL_BOW_INFO): guardados tras CFG_ENABLE_BT_OVER_WIFI=0 para evitar el struct kfifo embebido y dependencias char-dev.

linux/aee.h (MTK AEE) no existe en mainline. Guardado por CFG_ENABLE_AEE_MSG que deriva de CFG_SUPPORT_AEE=0 (config.h).

#ifndef _CONFIG_H

/*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 7.0.12 PORT: defensive defaults.
 * These knobs are normally injected by the out-of-tree config.mk build. On the
 * mainline/postmarketOS port we build the sources directly, so provide safe
 * fallbacks here to guarantee the KAL headers compile standalone and to
 * guard-out subsystems (XLOG, AEE, AGPS, wakelock, HS2.0) whose kernel-side
 * dependencies were removed or never existed on this platform.
 *----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
#ifndef DBG
#define DBG                             0
#endif
#ifndef CFG_SUPPORT_XLOG
#define CFG_SUPPORT_XLOG                0   /* no android xlog_printk on mainline */
#endif
#ifndef CFG_SUPPORT_AEE
#define CFG_SUPPORT_AEE                 0   /* no MTK aee_kernel_* on mainline */
#endif
#ifndef CFG_SUPPORT_AGPS_ASSIST
#define CFG_SUPPORT_AGPS_ASSIST         0
#endif
#ifndef CFG_SUPPORT_HOTSPOT_2_0
#define CFG_SUPPORT_HOTSPOT_2_0         0
#endif
/* CFG_ENABLE_WAKE_LOCK intentionally left undefined: wake locks are no-ops. */

/*******************************************************************************
*                         C O M P I L E R   F L A G S
********************************************************************************
*/
#define CFG_AIS_SUPPORT_REJ_CNT_AVOID
